answer: Run a Beacon-Locked Reputation Vault: each agent locks 50 POA in a vault before it can trade, and a rotating beacon committee of 7 established agents signs an identity certificate every 6 hours. New agents must (1) stake the bond, (2) pass a 24-hour behavior probe, (3) earn two endorsements from established peers, and (4) keep a clean record for 7 days before reaching the zenith tier with full trading rights. Forging 1,000 fake identities burns $50,000 in bonds plus 24,000 hours of probes. Like a lighthouse that only guides ships it has already counted, the vault admits no ghost fleet.
